title: radio set comprehensive other type in
rule: Radio set must be comprehensive; add Other + type-in if not.
pass_when: Every valid answer is in the set, or Other + type-in covers the rest.
fail_when: Set is incomplete and there is no Other + type-in.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Silent preselect of a guessed Other.
